shortDefinition.en: Focal length divided by entrance-pupil diameter under the usual photographic model; smaller numbers indicate wider relative openings.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 在通常摄影模型中为焦距除以入瞳直径，数值越小表示相对开孔越大。

en: The physical f-number does not change merely because the sensor format changes.
zh-cn: 仅仅更换传感器画幅，不会改变实际 F 值。

example.en: F4 describes half the entrance-pupil diameter of F2 at a given focal length.
example.zh-cn: 在给定焦距下，F4 的入瞳直径是 F2 的一半。

sources.title: Camera Exposure — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: The inverse f-number scale and its relationship to aperture area.
